title: Best Tattoo Designers (2026): Custom Tattoo Designs Online
description: How to hire a tattoo designer online for a custom design: placement, size, line work, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Online tattoo designers create custom designs that you take to your local tattoo artist. A good design fits your body placement, works at the planned size and ages well on skin. Projects go wrong when the design has lines too thin or details too small, the size is not considered, or the tattoo artist cannot use the file. This guide helps you get a design that works on skin, not only on screen.

faq.q: Will my tattoo artist use an online design?
faq.a: Many will, often adjusting it for your skin and placement. Talk to your tattoo artist first; some prefer to design themselves.

faq.q: Why does size matter so much?
faq.a: Small tattoos cannot hold fine detail. Lines too close together can blur over time. The designer should design for the real size.
